info.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales Universal API
info.description: Manage leads, opportunities, accounts, contacts, and sales records in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

recordId.description: Optional deterministic GUID. Sent as accountid in the POST body; omit to let Dataverse assign an ID.

fields.description: Required writable Dataverse columns by logical name, including grny_aspireid. Do not repeat accountid inside Fields; use Record ID.

accountid.description: GUID of the created Dynamics record, returned by Prefer: return=representation.

aspireOpportunityId.description: Required positive int32 Aspire OpportunityID. Sent as Dynamics opportunity.grny_aspireid in the POST body; duplicate values are rejected by active alternate key grny_uniqueaspireid.

fields.description: Required Opportunity JSON object using writable Dataverse logical column names. Include name (max 300). Use verified @odata.bind navigation properties for relationships. Omit grny_aspireid because it is in the URL; exclude statecode/statuscode and other unsupported fields.

opportunityid.description: GUID of the newly created Dynamics Opportunity returned by Prefer: return=representation with $select=opportunityid.
